idea-plugin.name: Modern CSS Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Live templates for modern CSS that you can use today: every template states its Baseline browser-support status. Works in CSS, SCSS, Less and <style> blocks (HTML, Vue); not in the indented Sass syntax, where braces are invalid. Type an abbreviation such as css-container-query and press Tab.

Templates

  • Layout: css-container-named, css-container-query, css-full-height, css-grid-auto, css-logical-spacing, css-media-range, css-scroll-snap, css-subgrid
  • Selectors: css-focus-visible, css-has, css-nth-of, css-where-reset
  • Architecture: css-component-bem, css-component-scope, css-component, css-container-style, css-layers, css-property, css-reset
  • Color: css-color-tokens, css-dark-mode, css-light-dark, css-relative-color
  • Typography: css-fluid-type, css-text-balance
  • Motion: css-dialog-animation, css-entry-animation, css-reduced-motion, css-smooth-scroll, css-view-transition
  • Accessibility: css-visually-hidden
  • Forms: css-field-sizing

Usage

Type the abbreviation and press Tab; press Tab again to move between the editable fields. Ctrl+J / ⌘J lists all templates. Customize them under Settings | Editor | Live Templates | Modern CSS Toolkit.

Privacy

The plugin collects no data and makes no network requests.

Source code: github.com/jamesmosq/modern-css-toolkit.
